name: artispreneur-epk-tools
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Suite for ArtistEPKs Platform

tools.name: update_epk
tools.description: Patches the live Electronic Press Kit data state in real time. Can update individual or multiple fields.

tools.name: fetch_spotify_data
tools.description: Pulls verified artist discography, monthly listeners, top tracks, and album cover art directly from Spotify Web API.

spotifyUrl.description: Full Spotify artist URL or URI

tools.name: scrape_social_profile
tools.description: Scrapes and verifies public follower and engagement metrics for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or Twitter/X.

tools.name: generate_tech_rider
tools.description: Generates a 24-channel audio input list, monitor mix preferences, stage plot layout, and hospitality specs for promoters.

tools.name: render_pdf_export
tools.description: Renders and compiles a vector multi-page PDF or a single-page Executive One-Sheet with clickable media links.

tools.name: search_promoter_venues
tools.description: Searches curated live music venues, festivals, and talent buyers matching the artist's genre and room capacity tier.
